t-modulus.source_version: Authors submitted manuscript with SI; third-party mirror, VUB provenance cover; not publisher version
t-modulus.locator: SI Youngs Modulus used in the simulation; Figure S7; PDF page 20 of 30
t-modulus.context_summary_by_assistant: Experimentally measured slope used as simulation input; 25 C, 65 percent/min, 0-5 percent strain regression, four samples. Not UTS or repaired-strength recovery.

t-device.title: Self-healing soft pneumatic robots
t-device.source_version: Authors submitted manuscript with SI; third-party mirror, VUB provenance cover; not publisher version
t-device.locator: Figure 8D caption and associated results; PDF pages 10-11 of 30; Methods page 13, SI page 18
t-device.context_summary_by_assistant: Pleated pneumatic muscle PPAM1: contraction force versus overpressure measured after three damage/repair cycles. Bending actuator BSPA3 separately tested through two cycles. Similar curves are not an extracted recovery percentage. First muscle cycle affected by oven orientation and cable tension. Detailed protocol: about 5 min heating +35 min at 80 C +28 min cooling to 25 C +24 h recovery at 25 C. Surfaces recontacted; repaired while deflated.
